name: formula_absolutionis.wav
description:
Cum igitur Poenitentem absolvere voluerit, injuncta ei prius, et ab eo acceptata salutari poenitentia, primo dicit:
"Misereatur tui, omnipotens Deus, et dimissis peccatis tuis, perducat te ad vitam aeternam. Amen".

Deinde dextera versus Poenitentem elevata, dicit:
"Indulgentiam, absolutionem, et remissionem peccatorum tuorum tribuat tibi omnipotens, et misercors Dominus. Amen. Dominus noster Jesus Christus te absolvat; et ego auctoritate ipsius te absolvo ab omni vinculo excommunicationis, suspensionis, et interdicti, in quantum possum, et tu indiges".

Deinde:
"Ego te absolvo a peccatis tuis, in nomine Patris, et Filii, et Spiritus Sancti. Amen".

From "Rituale Romanum" priest's manual edition 1847: Sin absolution formula.
The book describes the ritual punctiliously.

name: Early-Morning-suburban-road
description:
32-Bit Float, 48000Hz.

Just a few minutes long while I waited for my ride to work in the early hours. A few cars pass on the quiet suburban street, and a possum is wandering around behind me somewhere if you listen closely.

name: Noise In Ceiling.m4a
description: I recorded this animal noise in my ceiling. I have no idea what it could be so thought I would put it out there..!!  Sounds like there is more than one and sounding young. Possibilities are possum, bats, birds or rats. Any ideas?
